MedicalJobsAustralia.com     Associate Nurse Unit Manager - Periop Obstetrics and Gynaecology WCH





Job no: 945061

Work type: Part time

Located in: Adelaide CBD

Categories: Medical, Nursing-Midwifery




 

Women's and Children's Health Network, Surgical Services, North Adelaide (5006)

Salary - Classification - RN-M2A - Associate Nursing-Midwifery Unit Manager LV2 - $107,487 to $114,917 + 12% Superannuation and Salary Sacrifice Benefits

Part Time 0.84 FTE, Ongoing Permanent

About WCHN
Join the Women's and Children's Health Network (WCHN), South Australia's leading provider of care for women, babies, children and young people. We're shaping the future of healthcare through compassion, innovation and excellence - with our communities at the heart of everything we do.

What WCHN Can Offer You

Access to salary packaging benefits of up to $9,010 each FBT year for living expenses (e.g. mortgage, rent, utilities, groceries), plus an additional $2,650 each FBT year for meal entertainment expenses.

Access to Fitness Passport (workplace health and fitness program that gives you and your family access to a wide choice of gyms and pools across South Australia.)

Free public transport to and from the Women's and Children's Hospital for SA Health metropolitan hospital staff (excludes network community sites).

Support for you and your family via our Employee Assistance Program.

Relocation financial support may be negotiated, subject to eligibility. Click here for details and contact the enquires person for further information.

About the role

Provides perioperative nursing care in Instrument and Circulating Nurse roles, supporting Obstetrics and Gynaecology Surgery services on a seven-day rotating roster. Assists with managing the clinical needs of Obstetrics and Gynaecology surgical lists while ensuring safe, high-quality, person-centred perioperative patient care.

Key duties of the role

Provides clinical leadership and oversees the delivery of safe, person-centred nursing care, ensuring quality patient outcomes and effective patient flow.

Supports the Nurse Unit Manager with operational management, workforce coordination, resource allocation, budgeting, and service planning.

Leads and fosters a positive team culture focused on collaboration, customer service, safety, learning, and continuous improvement.

Supports staff development through clinical teaching, mentoring, supervision, and facilitating professional learning opportunities.

Contributes to quality improvement, research, clinical auditing, change management, and evidence-based practice initiatives.

Skills and Experience

Registered Nurse eligible for registration with the Nursing and Midwifery Board of Australia, holding or eligible to hold a current practising certificate.

Demonstrated experience in perioperative scrub-scout nursing, delivering safe, high-quality care aligned with National Safety and Quality Health Service Standards.

Strong leadership, communication, problem-solving, conflict resolution, and teamwork skills, with experience supporting students and less experienced nurses.

Proven ability to prioritise workloads, meet deadlines, and work effectively with minimal supervision in a dynamic healthcare environment.

Sound knowledge of healthcare legislation, professional standards, quality improvement, risk management, work health and safety, and person- and family-centred care principles.

Enquiries can be directed to

Kate Hanly

Position: Nursing Director - Theatres

Phone: 81617260

E-mail: Kate.Hanly@sa.gov.au

Drillers Wanted in Cairns!   Your new company     
 Our client is a well-established specialist ground engineering contractor delivering geotechnical and drilling solutions across Queensland. With a strong reputation for safety, quality, and technical expertise, they are seeking a motivated Drill Rig Operator / Excavator Operator to join their Cairns-based team and contribute to a variety of exciting projects across the region. 
   Your new role     
 Working on a Monday to Friday (5/2) roster, you will operate a 13-tonne Komatsu excavator fitted with a TEI drill mast across a range of civil and geotechnical projects. Based out of Cairns, you will generally work 10-12-hour days and play a key role in ensuring drilling operations are completed safely and efficiently. 
   
 Your responsibilities will include: 
 
 
 Operating a 13T Komatsu excavator with TEI drill mast attachments 
 
 
 Assisting with geotechnical and ground engineering projects 
 
 
 Conducting pre-start inspections and basic equipment maintenance 
 
 
 Working collaboratively with site crews and project teams 
 
 
 Ensuring compliance with workplace health and safety requirements 
 
 
 Travelling to regional project sites when required 
 
 
   What you'll need to succeed     
 To be successful in this role, you will have: 
 
 
 Previous experience operating excavators in civil, drilling, construction, or related environments 
 
 
 An Excavator Ticket/Ticketed competency (highly regarded) 
 
 
 White Card 
 
 
 Working at Heights certification (desirable) 
 
 
 HR Driving Licence (desirable) 
 
 
 Strong commitment to safety and quality workmanship 
 
 
 Ability to work extended 10-12-hour days when required 
 
 
 A positive attitude and willingness to travel for project work 
 
 
   What you'll get in return     
 
 
 Cairns-based role with a stable Monday to Friday roster 
 
 
 Opportunity to work on diverse and challenging projects across Queensland 
 
 
 Competitive hourly rate and ongoing work 
 
 
 Accommodation and meal allowance provided for away projects 
 
 
 Supportive team environment with a strong safety culture 
 
 
 Opportunity to develop your skills with a respected industry leader 
 
 
   What you need to do now     If you're an experienced operator looking for your next opportunity in a dynamic and growing business, we'd love to hear from you.    
 If you're interested in this role, forward an up-to-date copy of your CV to Hannah.hill@hays.com.au, or call Hannah on 07 4049 2975. If this job isn't quite right for you, but you are looking for a new position, please contact us for a confidential discussion on your career.  Please  click here  to apply.
